discovery_notes: Cell B075 BoxLunch 2020 (any maker). 30 standard searches, snippets only; Disney Pins Blog posts plus BoxLunch listings. No prior lic/2020 BoxLunch keys besides multi-retailer Funko jumbo series in 225; Keys aligned with concurrent Loungefly 2020 packet 257 for DL65, Mickey & Pluto set and NBC Puzzle blind box (corroboration); other keys use loungefly-boxlunch-<release> per rule 7. Blind boxes recorded as sets only, members held per rule 12. Three Dec 2020 pins possibly Uncas keyed boxlunch-only. Dates mostly from DPB 'released in' lines.
